name: AIOStreams
description: AIOStreams is a Stremio addon that combines and configures multiple stream sources, filters, and debrid options in one configurable installation. See the project documentation for Stremio setup and built-in addon notes.

paths.name: Data Folder
paths.description: Persistent data directory (SQLite database and application data). Maps to ./data in the upstream compose example.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to the container web UI (container listens on 3000 by default).

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public base URL of this instance (required). Used for install links, stream URLs, and built-in addons. Example: https://aiostreams.yourdomain.com — avoid a trailing slash.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: 64-character hex string for encrypting addon configuration. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Database URI
variables.description: Database connection string. Default SQLite path matches the Data Folder mount.

variables.name: Addon Name
variables.description: Display name for this addon instance.

variables.name: Addon ID
variables.description: Unique identifier for this addon instance; change if you run a distinct public instance.

variables.name: Addon Password
variables.description: Optional API/install password. Leave empty to disable. Multiple values allowed, comma-separated.

variables.name: Internal URL
variables.description: Optional override for how the server reaches itself (e.g. behind reverse proxy). Defaults to local container access.

variables.name: Redis URI
variables.description: Optional Redis URL for caching in scaled deployments. Leave blank for single-container setups.
